h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Khammam

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Khammam

items.pText: Khammam is a district town in eastern Telangana, near the Andhra Pradesh border, with granite quarries and farmland around it. Schools, colleges and housing layouts here ask us for play areas that get children playing together. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 800 km away, and delivers it to Khammam by road.

Some equipment is played on alone, and some only works with friends. A see-saw needs a partner, a merry-go-round needs someone to push, and a big structure with many routes turns into a game of chase. For schools that want children to mix across classes and friendships, we suggest putting more of the budget into these group pieces. Our Funplay Originals are designed with this kind of play in mind, and many take their ideas from games Indian children play together.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Equipment that gets children playing together

c: Group play pieces need more space around them, since children move in and out from several sides. Place them in the centre of the play area with the safe play area clearly marked. Our Nature Sparsh structures are built for several children at once, and the Khel Khud range draws on games played in groups. A see-saw and a merry-go-round complete the set. Khammam's summers are very hot, so shade the central pieces first and keep single swings at the edges.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 800 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Which playground equipment encourages group play?
items.a: See-saws, merry-go-rounds and larger structures with several routes, such as our Nature Sparsh and Khel Khud designs. They need more than one child to play, so children mix naturally.

items.q: Do group play pieces need more space?
items.a: Usually, since children approach them from several sides. We mark a clear safe play area around each one on the layout drawing so other equipment does not crowd it.

items.q: Do you supply schools in Khammam?
items.a: Yes. Schools, colleges and housing layouts in Khammam can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in Telangana.
